title: InventoryInspect
description: Server-side mod to view and manage player inventories and ender chests
body:
### ![InventoryInspect Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c1aed61ae2448184901bf302c658872d45fc8b79.png) 
# InventoryInspect

A barebones mod that allows server admins to view and manage the inventories and ender chests of other players.

Supports both online and offline players.

---

## Main Command: `/oinv`

Requires operator status or vanilla permission level 2 (`GAMEMASTERS`).

### Inventory Commands

`/oinv inventory`

### Ender Chest Commands

`/oinv enderchest`

After entering the command, specify the target player's username.

### GUI Access

* `/oinv inventory [player] open`

  * Opens a chest-style GUI for viewing and editing the player's inventory or ender chest.

The GUI is the recommended method, though several command-line subcommands are also available:

* `/oinv inventory [player] clear [slot]`

  * Clears the specified slot.

* `/oinv inventory [player] get [slot]`

  * Retrieves the item from the specified slot.

* `/oinv inventory [player] list`

  * Lists all inventory contents.

* `/oinv inventory [player] set [slot] [item]`

  * Sets an item in the specified slot.
